description: Vehicle dispatch economics used by the SajhaBazaar shared-freight engine. Per-km running cost is DERIVED from the real Maharashtra retail diesel prices in data/diesel_rates_maharashtra.json rather than hardcoded, so freight tracks fuel.
source: IOCL/HPCL/BPCL Maharashtra retail diesel RSP (2026-09-03) combined with All India Motor Transport Congress (AIMTC) light-commercial operating-cost norms and the 50-quintal truck charter rate corroborated in data/farmer_pooling_profiles.json.

cost_model.equation: TripCost(Q, D) = max(MinTripCharge, FixedVehicleBase + D * RatePerKm + Q * D * IncrementalPerQtlKm)
notes: FixedVehicleBase covers driver mobilisation, loading labour and APMC gate entry — it is incurred whether the vehicle carries 3 quintals or 30.
MinTripCharge is the floor a transporter will accept for a dedicated dispatch. This floor is what makes sub-scale individual haulage uneconomic and is the entire reason pooling creates value.
IncrementalPerQtlKm captures the extra fuel burn from payload weight; it is small, which is precisely why sharing a vehicle is close to free at the margin.
roundTripFactor is 2.0 because the vehicle must return empty from the APMC.

pickup_corridor.description: Extra road distance the vehicle drives to collect each additional farmer on the pooled route, on top of the direct origin-to-mandi leg.
